panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Real patient renal biopsy H&E at low power from the index MPA case; shows glomerular and tubulointerstitial involvement consistent with the diagnosed pauci-immune crescentic glomerulonephritis of microscopic polyangiitis. B: PAS-stained glomerulus from the same MPA patient showing a cellular crescent, the classic renal lesion of microscopic polyangiitis; disease attribution is explicit in the caption and in-text diagnosis. C: Silver-stained glomerulus from the MPA case clearly demonstrates crescentic glomerular injury, matching the pauci-immune crescentic glomerulonephritis that is the hallmark renal manifestation of microscopic polyangiitis. D: Masson's trichrome highlights fibrinoid necrosis and crescent formation in a glomerulus of the MPA patient, confirming necrotizing crescentic (pauci-immune) glomerulonephritis, the classic renal expression of microscopic polyangiitis.

panels.rationale: Single-panel Jones methenamine silver renal biopsy from a patient with MPO-ANCA microscopic polyangiitis (disease-focused article title and prior caption triage). The image visibly shows a glomerulus with fibrinoid necrosis and early crescent formation in the urinary space, i.e. necrotizing crescentic glomerulonephritis, a classic renal manifestation of microscopic polyangiitis; the in-text phrase 'necrotizing crescentic glomerulonephritis' is a listed synonym of the vocabulary finding. Confidence is moderated because the in-text notes 'significant IgA deposits (not shown in figure)', which tempers a strictly pauci-immune interpretation, but the silver-stain morphology itself and the article/prior-triage attribution support microscopic polyangiitis. panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Renal biopsy histology panel labeled 'Diffuse crescents' showing glomerular crescents; in-text confirms pauci-immune necrotizing crescentic glomerulonephritis anti-MPO/P-ANCA associated in a case of microscopic polyangiitis. B: Renal biopsy histology panel labeled 'Cellular crescent' showing a glomerular cellular crescent; in-text confirms pauci-immune crescentic glomerulonephritis in microscopic polyangiitis. C: Renal biopsy histology panel labeled 'GBM rupture' showing glomerular basement membrane rupture, a feature of necrotizing glomerulonephritis; in-text confirms pauci-immune necrotizing crescentic glomerulonephritis in microscopic polyangiitis. D: Renal biopsy histology panel labeled 'RBC casts' showing red blood cell casts in tubules, a manifestation of glomerulonephritis; in-text confirms pauci-immune necrotizing crescentic glomerulonephritis in microscopic polyangiitis.
